html:
Galkynysh is a natural gas field in southeast Turkmenistan, near Mary, found in 2006 and ranked among the two or three largest gas fields in the world.

It was first named South Yolotan. Its gas began flowing in 2013, developed largely by Chinese state firms, and most of it goes east through the pipeline to China, which became Turkmenistan's main buyer after Russia cut purchases in 2009.

Gas is almost the whole of Turkmenistan's export economy and paid for the marble city built by Saparmurat Niyazov and his successor. A planned pipeline south through Afghanistan to Pakistan and India has been talked about for decades and is still under construction.
sum: Galkynysh is a natural gas field in southeast Turkmenistan, near Mary, found in 2006 and ranked among the two or three largest gas fields in the world.
